title: Sign in – NoTiming
heading: Sign in
email.label: Email address
email.hint: We email you a six-digit code. No password needed.
code.sent: If this address can sign in, a code is on its way. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
code.label: Six-digit code
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s
error.code: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
error.passkey: That passkey could not sign you in. Try again, or use an emailed code.
passkeys.title: Passkeys – NoTiming
passkeys.heading: Your passkeys
passkeys.intro: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of an emailed code.
passkeys.offer: Add a passkey to this device, so next time signing in takes one tap.
passkeys.offerSecond: Add a passkey on a second device too, so losing one never locks you out.
passkeys.confirmRemove: Remove this passkey? It will no longer sign you in.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser or device cannot create a passkey. You can still sign in with an emailed code.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys are not available yet. You can still sign in with an emailed code.
passkeys.error.cancelled: No passkey was created. Nothing changed.
passkeys.error.failed: The passkey could not be added. Try again.
passkeys.error.last: You cannot remove your last passkey. Add another one first.
passkeys.error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
email.code.subject: Your NoTiming sign-in code
email.code.body:
Your NoTiming sign-in code is {code}.

It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without the code.
email.passkey.subject: A passkey was added to your NoTiming account
email.passkey.body:
A passkey{name} was added to your NoTiming account on {when}.

If this was you, there is nothing to do. If it was not, sign in with an emailed code and remove it under your passkeys.
